short_description: Construction runtime recovery, late-interest synchronization and replication-scale policy over accepted T1A.6 runtime networking.
purpose: Make canonical Construction runtime survive recovery/reconnect and replicate only relevant runtime state at scale while reusing existing persistence, authority and interest foundations instead of creating domain-private global infrastructure.
expected_outcome: Recovered runtime state preserves canonical revisions and effects, reconnect/late-interest clients converge from authoritative baselines, irrelevant constructs are not replicated, and scale behavior is bounded without changing permanent identity or authority ownership.
progress_note: T1A.7.2 Late-Interest Baseline + Reconnect is ACCEPTED on FIX1 runtime head d41d3d3721b61cc0464e1c5693ccaa4521b7819a after the required focused gate and a fresh full world/core regression with 6 PASS / 0 FAIL, clean STOPPED lifecycle and the NX4 final marker. T1A.7.3 is now implemented as a stacked candidate: a Construction-domain selective replication planner keeps reverse construct->logical-client projection, detects dirty runtime ids from authoritative snapshot checksum differences, and routes exact full construct runtime snapshots only to relevant active sessions. The accepted T1A.7.2 baseline/reconnect path remains the correctness fallback; no compact delta DTO, network channel, global interest identity, scheduler or protocol-manifest change is introduced. Windows focused validation and full regression are pending.
next_stage: Run T1A.7.3 dirty/selective focused Windows gate. If green, record the tested runtime head and run full world regression on the same runtime code; then accept T1A.7.3 and proceed to T1A.7.4 Scale / Soak Lab with 100/1,000 constructs and 10,000 runtime subjects.

ownership_claims.scope: Construction runtime recovery state, domain-specific interest projection, dirty runtime detection and selective construct fan-out
reuse existing AggregateTransactionRepository/Coordinator; no private T1 repository/coordinator
reuse existing RESYNC/RELIABLE_ORDERED correctness path; T1A.7.3 changes only Construction-domain target projection, not channel or transport policy
consume existing authority owner/epoch/session fences; no new permanent owner registry
consume authoritative upstream selection only; construct/runtime identity is not replaced by interest, LOD or camera identity
